Benefit Category
Durable Medical Equipment. Note that a determination that an item falls within a
benefit category is not a determination that the item is covered under any
particular circumstance.

Item/Service Description
A power mobility device is a powered wheelchair or power-operated vehicle supplied
for use within the beneficiary's home to address a mobility limitation.

Indications and Limitations of Coverage
A power mobility device is covered when all of the following are documented.

The beneficiary has a mobility limitation that significantly impairs the ability
to perform one or more mobility-related activities of daily living within the
home, and the limitation cannot be sufficiently resolved by a cane, walker, or
optimally configured manual wheelchair.

The ordering practitioner has conducted a face-to-face examination within the
forty-five days preceding the written order, and the examination record addresses
the mobility limitation directly.

The supplier has documented that the beneficiary's home can accommodate and permit
safe operation of the device, including doorway widths and surface conditions.

A power mobility device is not covered where the record documents that the
beneficiary is able to ambulate safely without assistance within the home, or
where the device is sought solely for use outside the home.

Cross Reference
See the applicable local coverage determination for wheelchair seating components.
